correctness.rationale: For arbitrary finite W, (U) and (MP) entail finite-conjunction closure and model-relative finite consequence closure. Thus H_w equals the formulas true throughout its common truth-set K_w; the canonical relation wRv iff v in K_w reproduces all modal truth by induction. Each finite modal type has a distinguishing conjunction, so any representing row must choose a nonempty subset of every type in K_w and exclude all others. Product counting and extremal edge counts follow. 1,310,720 exhaustive three-world comparisons and 46,592 sampled four-world comparisons passed; computations corroborate rather than prove the general result. Frame condition (G) was not confused with stronger model-relative (U).
